Subject: Acme discovery recap + next steps

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and I think there's a clear fit around serving cost-sensitive summarization and search at low latency. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Summary of needs: ~50 qps peak, multi-region read-only dataset, enterprise security (KMS + audit logs)
- Initial target scope: search reranking + customer message summarization (pilot)
- Timing: pilot ideally in Q2, full rollout depends on integration effort

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) I'll send a short pricing deck + estimate for the pilot (by end of week)
2) Schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to go through the deck and technical questions
3) Lauren will join on the pricing details and SLA discussion if helpful

If that sounds right I can send the deck now and propose times for a walkthrough next week.

Best,
